items.exampleEn: My old classmates and I get together every summer.
items.exampleZh: 我和老同學每年夏天都會聚一聚。

items.exampleEn: Please give my pen back after class.
items.exampleZh: 下課後請把我的筆還給我。

items.exampleEn: Please go on with your story.
The cat went away when it saw the dog.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓看到狗就走開了。

items.exampleEn: The kids are singing. Why don't you join in?
items.exampleZh: 孩子們在唱歌，你何不也加入？

items.exampleEn: Let's lie down on the grass and look at the sky.
items.exampleZh: 我們躺在草地上看天空吧。

items.sentenceEn: The party went on until midnight.

items.audioEn: Kevin lent me his bike, so I have to give it back tomorrow.
items.audioZh: Kevin 把腳踏車借給我，所以我明天得還他。
items.questionZh: 說話的人明天要做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Everyone joined in when the music started.
items.sentenceZh: 音樂一開始，大家都加入了。

items.sentenceEn: I hope the rain goes away by tomorrow.
items.sentenceZh: 我希望這場雨明天以前會停。

items.stemEn: My legs are tired, so I want to ____ on the sofa.
items.stemZh: 我的腿很累，所以我想在沙發上躺一下。

items.stemEn: The library wants us to ____ these books by Friday.
items.stemZh: 圖書館要我們在星期五以前把這些書還回去。

items.passageEn: Every Friday night, Lisa and her friends get together at her house. They eat snacks and listen to old songs. Last Friday, Lisa's little brother wanted to join in, so they taught him a card game. The game went on for two hours! At the end of the game, he picked up all the cards and gave them back. Then he asked, "Can I play again next week?" Lisa laughed and said yes.
items.passageZh: 每個星期五晚上，Lisa 和朋友們都會在她家聚會。他們吃點心、聽老歌。上星期五，Lisa 的弟弟想加入，所以他們教他玩一種紙牌遊戲。遊戲一玩就是兩個小時！最後，他把所有的牌撿起來還給他們，然後問：「我下星期可以再玩嗎？」Lisa 笑著說好。

questions.questionZh: Lisa 和朋友每個星期五晚上做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我爸爸開車時喜歡聽收音機。
referenceEn: My dad likes to listen to the radio when he drives.
My father likes listening to the radio when he drives.
When my dad drives, he likes to listen to the radio.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 listen to the radio 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 likes having the radio on 等）也算對
「喜歡」後可接 to＋原形或動名詞（例如 likes to listen、likes listening 等）
「爸爸」可寫，例如 dad、father 等；when 子句可放句首或句尾

items.promptZh: 我明天會把你的字典還你。
referenceEn: I'll give back your dictionary tomorrow.
I will give your dictionary back tomorrow.
Tomorrow I will give your dictionary back to you.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 give back 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 return your dictionary 等）也算對
受詞可放在片語後面或中間（例如 give back your dictionary、give your dictionary back 等）
明天的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will give、am going to give 等）
